newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow police seeking man who stabbed five.
newsitem.headline: Moscow police seeking man who stabbed five.

text.p: A man in an apparently crazed state stabbed five women in Moscow, police said on Sunday.
Police said the man, aged 20 to 25, attacked the women in a northwestern residential part of the city over a period of about 20 minutes late on Saturday before fleeing the scene.
The victims, aged 15 to 55, were taken to hospital and were in conditions described as ranging from stable to serious.
